E4Plus1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4Plus1.uk.description: WrestleMania: Murray buys WrestleMania tickets to spend time with Barry and Adam, only to find that the tickets are fakes and they can't get in. Guest starring Hulk Hogan. (S7 Ep7)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: New Kids on the Block: Haley is determined to follow the advice in her parenting books with the twins, but Phil and Claire think their old methods are better. (S11 Ep1)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Snapped: Claire needs to clear the house before anyone makes her look bad in front of a reporter from an important women's business magazine. Jay invites Manny to a wine tasting. (S11 Ep2)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Rude(ish) Tube Shorts
E4Plus1.uk.description: A short, cheeky clip from Rude Tube's naughty little sister, Rude(ish) Tube, featuring sports of the lawnmower, motorbike and bicycle variety.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Greek at the Harbor: Gordon Ramsay helps a family-run Greek restaurant turn its fortunes around in Ventura Harbor in California. But he uncovers a shocking family secret... (S5 Ep7) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Beverly Goldberg Cookbook, Part 2: When a publisher shows interest in her recipes, Beverly prepares to finally realise her dream of writing a cookbook. (S7 Ep9)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4Plus1.uk.description: It's a Wonderful Life: When Beverly signs everyone up for a holiday family photo, Geoff is excited to join in - despite Erica's reservations. (S7 Ep10)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Up All Night: Gloria isn't happy with Jay's reaction to the arrival of Javier, Manny's infamously unreliable dad. Phil is suffering from kidney stones. (S1 Ep11)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Fifteen Percent: Mitchell seeks revenge when Jay introduces Cameron as just his 'friend'. Gloria gives Manny's date a makeover. (S1 Ep13)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Married at First Sight Australia
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: Intimacy Week reaches boiling point as one relationship threatens to implode, and a bride makes a decision that breaks her groom's heart. (S13 Ep11)

E4Plus1.uk.title: First Dates
E4Plus1.uk.description: Madeleine has a weakness for rugby fellas while Sophie says she often picks the wrong guy. Publican Branislav has been single for over a year and can't wait to start flirting. (S18 Ep4)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: Mike and Nellie's: In Oakhurst, Gordon Ramsay helps the overwhelmed owner of Mike and Nellie's restaurant, who lost his way when his father and business partner died. (S5 Ep8)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Marge Gamer: Marge gets hooked on an online fantasy game and discovers that Bart is the game's best - and most destructive - player. (S18 Ep17/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Boys of Bummer: Just as the Springfield Isotopes are on the verge of winning their first Little League Championship, Bart makes a mistake that costs the team their title. (S18 Ep18/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Airport 2010: For Jay's birthday, Gloria surprises him with a getaway to Hawaii - but she's invited the whole family. And there's no greater test than travelling with the family. (S1 Ep22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Hawaii: A relaxing family vacation in Hawaii gets slightly derailed when everyone has their own ideas of fun. (S1 Ep23)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Married at First Sight Australia
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: Intimacy Week reaches boiling point as one relationship threatens to implode, and a bride makes a decision that breaks her groom's heart. (S13 Ep11)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Celebrity Coach Trip
E4Plus1.uk.description: Fun at the water park ends dramatically for one celeb on the penultimate day of Brendan's star-studded tour. With the final looming, everyone is on tenterhooks. (S4 Ep14)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Penny-Wiseguys: When mobster Fat Tony has to do jury service, he puts mild-mannered accountant Dan Gillick (voiced by Steve Carell) in charge of his criminal organisation. (S24 Ep5/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: A Tree Grows in Springfield: Homer becomes addicted to a tablet that Lisa wins for him in the school's silent auction, but he's distraught when it gets broken. (S24 Ep6/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Mothers and Other Strangers: Homer does therapy to cope with missing his mother, sending him on a trip down memory lane, to when he and Grampa went on a road trip to find her. (S33 Ep9)

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: Married at First Sight...
E4Plus1.uk.description: ...Australia - Brand new series: The dinner party descends into chaos when a shock return re-ignites old feuds and exposes fresh cracks in multiple marriages. (S13 Ep12)

E4Plus1.uk.title: New: MAFS Australia: After the...
E4Plus1.uk.description: ...Dinner Party - Brand new series: Brides and grooms settle old scores and spill behind-the-scenes drama from the current series, starting with Alissa, Stella, Chris and Danny. (S1 Ep1)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: Britain's sharpest armchair critics watch: Banged Up: Stars Behind Bars, Planet Earth, Bake Off, Culprits, The Curse of Robert the Doll and much more. (S22 Ep10)
